note: Method: IMSLP API wikitext for all 231 pages; Deezer (per-work track searches, album sweeps, about 190 album track lists), MusicBrainz, Apple (partly, it was slow) and 14 web searches. Deezer and MusicBrainz missed discs on other labels or spellings (cpo's Kößler, Albany, Resonus, EM Records), so 'not performed or recorded' is weaker for the print-only pages of Blanc, Walckiers, Jadassohn, Thieriot, Caetani, Marteau (String Trio) and Nováček. For the owner: (1) Lanner's 12 waltz sets (original scoring 3 violins and bass): only orchestral, ensemble or quartet-arrangement recordings found, all skipped. (2) Doppler Op. 36 is kept in the flute/violin/piano version that the print names beside two flutes (recorded by Arimany); Op. 37 and Op. 34 are out (recorded without strings). (3) Walckiers' flute quartets Opp. 46, 70, 103 on the same discs are for four flutes, so out. (4) Busoni's Op. 17 concerto is kept for its piano and string quartet version on a MusicBrainz recording listing (release and players not opened). (5) Keys where IMSLP and labels disagree: Jadassohn Op. 20 (key left out), Dietrich Op. 9 (two labels: C major), Glass Op. 22 (cpo: C minor), Busoni Quartet 1 (labels: C major), Kienzl Quartet 1 (IMSLP B-flat minor, Deezer B minor). Holbrooke's IMSLP Clarinet Quintet No. 1, Op. 27a is cpo's Quintet No. 2, Op. 27 (Ligeia) in G minor. (6) Marteau's Bogenstudien Op. 14 (violin id 3893) is a duo for two violins, not cross-listed. (7) 15 works not on IMSLP were added from discs: Marx's three quartets, Holbrooke Piano Quartet Op. 21, Tovey Trio Op. 8, Andrée Trio No. 1 and nine by Thieriot (3 string quartets, 2 piano quartets, 2 string trios, a sextet, the Op. 29 variations). (8) Thieriot's String Octet Op. 78 appears only on Toccata vol. 5, listed for 6 Nov 2026 (not yet issued). (9) Kirchner's Kindertrios (flagged pedagogical?) are kept because they are on a commercial disc. The Mackenzie, Kirchner Op. 84, Friskin trio Phantasie, Schuberth, Busoni Op. 17 and Thieriot additions rest on weaker evidence (library record, retailer or Qobuz listings, an IMSLP note, a single track) and carry medium confidence.
